name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
use_and_limitations: Technical application-security verification baseline; checklist maps relevant families and is not a verbatim full ASVS export.

name: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide
use_and_limitations: Testing methodology and test-family reference; some tests require accounts, code access, specialist tools, or manual validation.

name: OWASP Top 10
use_and_limitations: Risk-awareness taxonomy; not a complete test suite or certification standard.

name: OWASP API Security Top 10
use_and_limitations: API risk taxonomy; BOLA, authentication, property/function authorization, resource use, SSRF, inventory and unsafe API consumption require contextual tests.

name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
use_and_limitations: Practical guidance, not a certifiable standard; use topic-specific current sheets.

name: OWASP Software Assurance Maturity Model
use_and_limitations: Maturity model for governance, design, implementation, verification and operations; primarily evidence/interview based.

name: OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard
version_or_status: Current project edition; verify at assessment time
applicability: Only if native/hybrid mobile clients are in scope
use_and_limitations: Mobile-app standard; a web-only scan cannot establish mobile conformance.

name: OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide
applicability: Only for mobile apps and their platform interactions
use_and_limitations: Mobile testing methodology; requires binaries/devices/source in many cases.

name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
applicability: Only where LLM/GenAI features or agents exist
use_and_limitations: AI-specific risk awareness, including prompt injection, data disclosure, supply chain, poisoning, output handling and excessive agency.

name: OWASP Automated Threats to Web Applications
version_or_status: 2023 project edition / verify current project page
applicability: Public-facing signup, checkout, scraping and sensitive flows
use_and_limitations: Bot/automation-abuse guidance; detection often needs business telemetry and product owner input.

name: OWASP Cloud-Native Application Security Top 10
applicability: Cloud-native, container, orchestration and microservice deployments
use_and_limitations: Use as supplemental guidance only, not as a stable compliance baseline.

name: NIST SP 800-115
use_and_limitations: Assessment methodology; it explicitly is not a complete organization-wide testing program.

name: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework
use_and_limitations: Process controls for producing and maintaining secure software.

name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
use_and_limitations: Outcome taxonomy across Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover; not a prescriptive checklist by itself.

name: NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls
use_and_limitations: Large control catalog; this checklist maps broad families, not every control enhancement.

name: NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines
applicability: Identity proofing, authentication and federation; especially relevant government systems
use_and_limitations: Use the applicable 63A/63B/63C volume and assurance level; web observation alone cannot prove conformance.

name: NIST Privacy Framework
use_and_limitations: Voluntary privacy risk framework; does not itself establish legal compliance.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
applicability: Systems using AI/ML in consequential or user-facing workflows
use_and_limitations: AI lifecycle risk-management support; combine with a suitable use-case profile.

name: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile
use_and_limitations: AI-specific supplementary risk practices; not a web scanner test suite.

name: NIST SP 800-61 Incident Response
use_and_limitations: Incident response practices integrated with cybersecurity risk management.

name: ISO/IEC 27001
use_and_limitations: Requires organizational context, risk treatment, audit and management-system evidence; tool results cannot imply certification.

name: ISO/IEC 27002
use_and_limitations: Control guidance supporting selection/implementation of information-security controls.

name: ISO/IEC 27034-1 Application Security
use_and_limitations: Application-security concepts and lifecycle guidance.

name: ISO/IEC 27017 Cloud Security Controls
use_and_limitations: Cloud-specific allocation of responsibilities; applicability depends on cloud model and contract.

name: ISO/IEC 27701 Privacy Information Management
applicability: PII controllers/processors needing a privacy management system
use_and_limitations: Privacy management system; cannot be concluded from external scanning alone.

name: ISO/IEC 27035-1 Incident Management
use_and_limitations: Process guidance covering preparation, detection, reporting, response and lessons learned.

name: ISO/IEC 29147 Vulnerability Disclosure
use_and_limitations: Coordinated disclosure policy and communications; applicable to product vendors.

name: ISO/IEC 30111 Vulnerability Handling
use_and_limitations: Process for receiving, assessing, prioritizing and resolving potential vulnerabilities.

name: ISO 31000 Risk Management
use_and_limitations: General risk-management guidelines, not a security testing specification.

name: EU General Data Protection Regulation
applicability: Personal data processing within GDPR territorial/material scope
use_and_limitations: Conditional legal mapping; legal counsel/DPO must determine applicability and lawful basis. This checklist is not legal advice.

name: EU NIS2 Directive
applicability: Entities/sectors covered by applicable national implementation
use_and_limitations: Scope depends on sector, size, jurisdiction and national transposition.

name: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act
applicability: Financial entities and relevant ICT third-party arrangements
use_and_limitations: Conditional sectoral requirements; validate legal scope and detailed RTS/ITS obligations.

name: PCI DSS
applicability: Environments in scope for payment account data
use_and_limitations: Use official PCI SSC documents and a qualified assessor as applicable; scan output does not prove PCI compliance.

name: HIPAA Security Rule
version_or_status: Current U.S. HHS rule and guidance
applicability: Covered entities/business associates handling ePHI in U.S. scope
use_and_limitations: Conditional legal/regulatory scope; consult HIPAA specialists.

name: AICPA Trust Services Criteria / SOC 2
version_or_status: Current licensed criteria; verify with AICPA
use_and_limitations: SOC 2 is an examination/reporting engagement, not a product certification; criteria text may be licensed.

name: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
use_and_limitations: Accessibility, not a cybersecurity standard; automated checks cover only part of success criteria.

name: ETSI EN 301 549 accessibility requirements for ICT
applicability: Public-sector/regulated ICT accessibility requirements, particularly Europe
use_and_limitations: Check applicable edition and local procurement/legal obligations.

name: OpenAPI Specification
applicability: REST API contract discovery and linting
use_and_limitations: Contract validity is separate from runtime authorization/security.

name: JSON Schema
version_or_status: 2020-12 family; verify dialect declared by API
use_and_limitations: Schema validation does not prove authorization or business logic correctness.

name: IETF RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics
applicability: HTTP methods, status codes, fields and semantics
use_and_limitations: Protocol semantics; related companion RFCs may apply.

name: IETF RFC 8446 TLS 1.3
use_and_limitations: Pair with current TLS best-current-practice guidance and operational constraints.

name: IETF RFC 9325 and updates including RFC 9852
use_and_limitations: New protocols using TLS must require TLS 1.3; deployed compatibility profiles still need context-specific assessment.

name: IETF RFC 6797 HTTP Strict Transport Security
use_and_limitations: Validate HSTS header semantics and deployment preconditions.

name: IETF RFC 9700 OAuth 2.0 Security BCP
use_and_limitations: OAuth-specific configuration and flow testing requires endpoints, clients and role-aware test accounts.

name: IETF RFC 8725 JWT Best Current Practices
applicability: Systems that issue or consume JWTs
use_and_limitations: JWT parsing/validation behavior requires application or authorization-server context.

name: OpenID Connect Core
version_or_status: 1.0 with errata; verify current spec set
use_and_limitations: Redirect URI, nonce, state, issuer, audience and token validation need flow-level tests.

name: IETF RFC 7636 PKCE
use_and_limitations: Use current OAuth security BCP alongside PKCE.

name: IETF RFC 6265 HTTP State Management Mechanism
use_and_limitations: Browser cookie controls evolve; use current browser/platform behavior too.

name: W3C Content Security Policy Level 3
version_or_status: Living/current published spec; check status at use time
use_and_limitations: Policy presence alone does not establish resistance to all script injection.

name: W3C Subresource Integrity
applicability: Integrity of eligible third-party static assets
use_and_limitations: Does not protect all dynamic resources or script supply-chain paths.

name: OASIS SARIF
use_and_limitations: Validate schema, rule metadata, locations and redaction before export.

name: CycloneDX SBOM / supply-chain specification
applicability: Software bill of materials and components/services
use_and_limitations: Generate real BOM from resolved build artifacts/tools; declared requirements-only inventory is not a complete SBOM.

name: SPDX Software Package Data Exchange
version_or_status: 3.x specification family; pin schema in production
use_and_limitations: Select a specific schema version and validate SPDX output against its official schema.

name: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts
applicability: Build integrity, provenance and supply-chain assurance
use_and_limitations: Claims require builder/source provenance evidence; not established by a local test count.

name: OpenSSF Scorecard
use_and_limitations: Objective repository checks; not a full secure software audit.

name: MITRE CWE Top 25
use_and_limitations: Use as prioritization taxonomy; not all weaknesses can be discovered from black-box web scanning.

name: MITRE CAPEC
use_and_limitations: Use to structure threat models and test ideas, not as evidence of exploitability.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
use_and_limitations: ATT&CK is an adversary behavior knowledge base, not a web-app compliance standard.

name: FIRST Common Vulnerability Scoring System
use_and_limitations: When publishing CVSS, provide the score and vector; do not relabel heuristic risk scores as CVSS.

name: FIRST Exploit Prediction Scoring System
applicability: Prioritization of known CVEs with exploit-likelihood estimate
use_and_limitations: Requires CVE matching and current EPSS data; not a vulnerability severity score.

name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
use_and_limitations: Requires inventory/CVE matching; do not assert a web finding is KEV-listed without a CVE match.

name: CIS Critical Security Controls
use_and_limitations: Broad safeguard mapping; applicability depends on IG, asset class and organizational context.

name: CIS Benchmarks
applicability: OS, cloud, containers, Kubernetes, database and platform hardening
use_and_limitations: Use only the benchmark for the exact product/version; requires authorized configuration access.

name: CISA Secure by Design Pledge
applicability: Software manufacturers and product security practices
use_and_limitations: Voluntary, not a legal certification; assess published measurable goals when applicable.

name: FIPS 140-3 Cryptographic Module Validation
applicability: When validated cryptographic module requirement applies
use_and_limitations: Application-level use of a crypto library does not establish that a deployed module is validated.

name: ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System
applicability: Organizations operating AI systems and seeking an AI management system
use_and_limitations: Organization-level AI management system; conditional on AI use and desired assurance.

name: in-toto / provenance attestations
applicability: Software build attestations and artifact supply-chain
use_and_limitations: Require cryptographically verifiable provenance tied to immutable artifacts/builders.
